visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a brown bob hairstyle and a white T-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor living room, facing the camera. She speaks with expressive facial movements, smiling and raising her right index finger to emphasize her point. (2) The woman holds up a smartphone, displaying a delivery application's user interface. She points her finger at the screen, which shows various product categories and Costco branding. (3) The scene transitions to a high-definition screen recording of the mobile app. It lists products like 'Guava Lemon Green Tea' with comparative pricing for members and non-members. (4) The woman reappears, speaking directly to the viewer while holding her phone. She gestures with her hands as she explains the price differences between app ordering and in-store shopping. (5) A rapid-fire montage of screen captures follows, scrolling through categories like pet supplies, furniture, cleaning products, and fresh food. The scrolling is fast and continuous. (6) The woman continues her narration, using her hands to describe specific popular items like roasted chicken and beef noodles. Her expressions are lively and engaging. (7) A digital interface shows a Costco membership card being linked, followed by a blue checkmark animation and a success message. (8) A man with black hair and tattoos on his forearms appears, standing in a hallway near a door. He is holding a large bulk pack of Kirkland Signature tissues and a plastic bag containing bananas and other items. He speaks toward the camera with a neutral expression. (9) The camera remains on the man as he explains the delivery process, gesturing with his head and upper body while maintaining his grip on the heavy grocery items.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 聽說好市多現在也開放外送了. [Variety]: 好市多美食外送. (2) [Subtitle]: 剛剛就打開了. 發現真的已經有了耶. (3) [Logo]: Costco 好市多 新莊店. (4) [Subtitle]: 芭樂檸檬綠茶會員價是$201. 非會員是$243. 大概差30-40塊錢左右. (5) [Subtitle]: 也有差比較多的. 麻辣肥腸非會員呢. 他就貴了$109. (6) [Subtitle]: 很多人應該都會買好市多的衛生紙. 我就去查了一下. 實體賣場價格是369元. 所以實際去賣場買. [Slogan]: 你可能還是可以便宜個20-30塊. (7) [Variety]: 寢具家飾、熱門產品、清潔保養、民生食品、零食糖果、生鮮熟食、保健食品、冷凍冷藏、生活家電、辦公數位周邊暢銷商品、戶外、餐廚用品、飲料、烘焙點心. (8) [Subtitle]: 我發現大家最常買的烤雞. 還有我最近蠻喜歡吃的青花椒牛肉麵. 冷藏無骨牛小排肉片那個也沒有. (9) [Subtitle]: 輸入完我的卡號之後呢. (10) [Logo]: Costco. [Subtitle]: 就會顯示說你的帳戶已連結! (11) [Subtitle]: 所有的價格都會通通變成是會員價. (12) [Subtitle]: 下單完成了. 他寫最快十分鐘. 最晚呢半個小時會到. (13) [Logo]: J-plus motu. [Subtitle]: (35分鐘後送達). 欸但是他是熊貓送來的??? 為什麼? 他說他們後台看得到很多好市多的單子. 他看了一下之後發現. 我們這單東西他也可以接受. 所以他就過去. 他也很好奇. 他就問了一下那邊的人. 那邊的人說. 好市多的演算法會自己判斷. 如果客人買的東西比較多的話. 他們就會自己接下來. 然後用那個大車車送. 但如果他們判斷這個單不需要用到大車. 他們就會派給外送這樣. 覺得是一個蠻酷的體驗. 非會員的人多花一點點錢你還是可以吃到好市多的東西.
